notes.title: Patch v0.9.15
notes.content:
During this week we made a several changes that were inspired by your suggestions. Also we worked hard to make sound quality throughout the game significantly better. 

[list]
[*] Now you can use your telekinesis on troll's projectiles. If you throw troll's projectile back at him, he will take serious damage.
[*] In rare cases the boss of Chapter 3 could not appear on his place. Now this bug has been fixed.
[*] In the Chapter 3, it was possible to go through the textures in the certain underwater place. Fixed.
[*] We reworked a number of sounds, such as obtaining certain spells, the falling of large stones and other background sounds.
[*] The relative volume of many sounds has been changed.
[*] New secret caches were added into Chapters 1 and 2.
[/list]

We hope that you will enjoy this changes. Thanks for playing.

notes.title: First day patch (Patch v0.910)
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed typos in the text.
[*] New achievements have been added.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Chapter 3 - lever in the mirror room could be pulled several times.
[*] After receiving the devil's hands, tutorial is now shown almost immediately.
[*] Fixed a bug in the Chapter 3, when after reloading to the last checkpoint one of the ships remained in the air.
[*] Fixed a bug with the generator, when the sound from it could be heard before you turn it on.
[*] Volume of the generators has been changed.
[*] Now Chapter 3 has more health and shield bonuses.
[*] In the Chapter 3, invisible walls has been added to the last hall. Now you can't jump out of the window.  
[*] In the final arena you were able open the passage just after the killing of clawfoots. Fixed.
[*] During the battle with the worms in the second chapter the door could be open before the battle was over. Fixed.
[*] In the Chapter 1, it was possible to go through the textures in the certain under water places. Fixed.
[*] Reduced the number of clawfoots in the Chapter 1.
[*] The list of the people who supported our game on Indiegogo has been added to the credits. You are awesome! Thank you!
[/list]

We apologize for the large size of the patch. This happened because of the change in the location of the static objects in the first chapter, which led to the recalculation of the shadows. The corresponding file has been changed so it will be downloaded again in this patch. Sorry for inconvenience.
